LanguageData.DeltaV_GrappleDesc: Aim the grapple. Movable targets pull both ways; cargo is stowed on contact, personnel are carried, and structures pull the user toward them.
LanguageData.DeltaV_GrappleNoTarget: No grapple target lies in that direction.
LanguageData.DeltaV_GrappleReceiveBlocked: The target was reached but cannot be received or carried.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PersonnelLandingDesc: Select a standable moon pool, open docking port, uncovered deck, or deck cell directly beside vacuum on a friendly or hostile vessel. The pawn flies to that exact cell and enters; collision avoidance stays enabled and walls are never breached.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PersonnelLandingCancelDesc: Stop tracking the target structure and resume EVA flight at the current position and velocity.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PersonnelLandingBlocked: The selected cell is not a standable moon pool, open docking port, uncovered deck, or deck cell beside vacuum.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PersonnelLandingComplete: The EVA pawn entered the vessel.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PersonnelLandingFailed: Boarding failed; the pawn remains in EVA flight.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PawnSpaceflightExitDesc: Leave through a moon pool, open docking port, uncovered deck, or deck edge beside vacuum. The exit is checked only when clicked. The pawn first becomes a floating space object, then controllable EVA flight when capable.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PawnSpaceflightNoOpenEdge: The pawn must stand on a moon pool, open docking port, uncovered deck, or deck edge beside vacuum, and may not be carrying another object.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PawnSpaceflightNoMobilityWarning: {0} is not wearing torso-covering apparel that provides vacuum resistance. After exiting they will remain an uncontrollable drifting object and must be carried back by EVA-capable personnel or recovered by a tractor system.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PawnSpaceflightVacuumWarningMobil: {0} has insufficient vacuum resistance. They can still maneuver after exiting, but prolonged exposure will cause harm.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PawnSpaceflightVacuumWarningDrift: {0} also has insufficient vacuum resistance; if they later enter a mapped vacuum environment where they can maneuver, prolonged exposure will cause harm.
LanguageData.DeltaV_HardDockNoTarget: No enterable structure is present there.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PawnSpaceflightEquipmentLocked: Equipment cannot be changed, removed, or voluntarily dropped during EVA flight.
LanguageData.DeltaV_PawnSpaceflightCargoDropFailed: That item could not be ejected into space.
